question: Is the original frozen Stage1 A_0 SOXL-relative selection loss, especially 2026Q3, concentrated in a few anomalous price days or distributed across many normal open-to-open intervals? A concentration result only directs a separate source-quality audit; it is not a tradable rule.

fixed_statistics.negative_day_concentration: For each all/quarter segment report count, total negative/positive, shares of negative magnitude from worst 2 and worst 5 (min with available negatives), and effective negative loss days=(sum_abs)^2/sum_squared_abs; no threshold or data-driven gate.
fixed_statistics.forward_price_context: For the same trade-to-exit interval compute raw and normalized SOXL and SOXX open-price simple returns from frame.raw_[asset]_exit_open/frame.raw_[asset]_open -1 and frame.[asset]_exit_open/frame.[asset]_open -1. These are descriptive price returns, not fee-net physical contributions. Prior frame.soxl_return is never used as forward return.
preidentified_comparisons: original worst126 from 2023-08-01 trade to 2024-01-31 exit
fixed_statistics.source_quality_read: Inspect every Q3 negative selection day and all Q3 raw-vs-normalized price ratio discrepancies, retaining all daily rows. A difference needs separate original source/corporate-action audit; no trade decision from these dates.

stop: Any source hash/date/calendar or physical selection totals mismatch stops. Do not turn top-day list into regime switch, model training or account replay.
